description: Lists a subreddit's post (link) flair templates by name: the flairs a new post in that community can carry. Returns `subreddit`, `count` and `flairs`, each with `id` (the value a post submission takes as flair_id), `text`, `editable` (true when a custom flair_text is accepted with that id), `type` (text or richtext), `background_color`, `text_color`, `css_class`, `mod_only`, `max_emojis`, `allowable_content` and `richtext`. Many subreddits remove a post that has no flair. Reddit lists flairs only to signed-in accounts, so the read runs as the Reddit session connected for this API key; with none connected it answers 503 SESSION_REQUIRED before Reddit is asked, and that answer is not charged. A moderator's session sees every template, mod-only ones included; any other account sees the templates it can post with, listed with mod_only false. A subreddit with no post flairs returns an empty list. Billed at the read rate, including a 403 or 404 from Reddit. Example: name='SaaS'.

name.description: Subreddit name WITHOUT the r/ prefix (e.g. 'SaaS'), 1 to 21 letters, digits or underscores. Required (path parameter).

name: reddit_subreddit_flairs
title: List Subreddit Post Flairs
